main_text.l: Dicendi genera omnia Ciceronis & Hermogenis ad tria genera accommodata:
main_text.p: Neq; tamen, quòd ita genera distiximus, & inter se comparauimus, conciliauimusq;, exiftimandum eft, nō posse miscéri, si res ista poscat. Quinetiam quædam ita communia omnium, & singulorum generum sunt, ut sine illis nulla possit esse laudabilis oratio: cuiusmodi sunt, latinum, planum, siue dilucidum, & probabile.

page.notes: Diagram reconstructed from the braces; the word "dicitur." sits beside the right brace. Some words in the diagram and lower text are slightly blurred; "miscéri" and "exiftimandum" read with some uncertainty. The bottom word "Di-" is a hyphenated line-end, not a catchword.
